title: Influence of Exosomes on Astrocytes in Lung Cancer Brain Metastases
author: Ye, Wu, et al.

steps.title: Culture H1299 cells
steps.instruction: Obtain H1299 cells (Zhejiang Meisen Cell Technology Co., Ltd.) and grow them in complete RPMI‑1640 medium at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. When confluence exceeds 90 %, discard the medium, add 1 ml trypsin solution, incubate 3 min in the incubator until cells detach, then neutralize with complete 1640 medium, centrifuge, resuspend the pellet and seed an appropriate volume into a fresh culture flask with fresh complete medium.

steps.title: Isolate exosomes from supernatant
steps.instruction: Collect the culture supernatant from H1299 cells and centrifuge at 2000 g for 30 min to remove cells and debris. Transfer the cleared supernatant to a new tube, add the recommended volume of exosome separation reagent, shake and mix thoroughly, then incubate overnight at 2 °C–8 °C. Centrifuge the mixture at 4 °C, 10 000 g for 1 h, discard the supernatant, add an appropriate volume of PBS to resuspend the pellet‑bound exosomes, and store the exosome suspension at –20 °C.

steps.title: Treat SVG P12 cells with exosomes
steps.instruction: Seed SVG P12 astrocyte cells in appropriate culture vessels, then add H1299‑derived exosomes to a final concentration of 60 µg ml⁻¹. Incubate the co‑culture for 24 h at standard cell‑culture conditions (37 °C, 5 % CO₂).

steps.title: Harvest SVG P12 cells for apoptosis assay
steps.instruction: Detach SVG P12 cells using EDTA‑free trypsin, centrifuge the suspension at 1000 g for 5 min, discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 1 ml PBS. Count cells and aliquot 50 000–100 000 cells into 1.5 ml EP tubes, then centrifuge and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Stain cells with Annexin V‑FITC and PI
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in Annexin‑V‑FITC solution, add propidium iodide stain, and incubate the tubes at room temperature, protected from light, for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Acquire apoptosis data by flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Analyze the stained SVG P12 cells on a flow cytometer, recording early and late apoptotic populations. Use FlowJo software for data analysis.

steps.title: Perform label‑free quantitative proteomics
steps.instruction: Extract proteins from the exosome (or cell) sample, run SDS‑PAGE electrophoresis, stain the gel with Coomassie brilliant blue, and perform FASP enzymatic digestion. Separate the resulting peptides on an Easy nLC system, then analyse them with an Orbitrap Exploris 480 mass spectrometer. Process raw files with MaxQuant (v1.6.14.0) using the LFQ algorithm, annotate protein functions with Blast2GO, assign KEGG pathways with KOALA, evaluate enrichment by Fisher’s Exact Test, and predict subcellular locations with WoLF PSORT.

steps.title: Statistical analysis of results
steps.instruction: Analyze flow‑cytometry data with FlowJo and CCK‑8 data with GraphPad Prism 9. Compare groups using an unpaired t‑test; consider P < 0.05 as statistically significant.
